evals.name: open-ended-full-pass
evals.prompt: Analyze the whole game and make it better. Pick a handful of improvements or new features, give each one to a subagent to build, and when they're done merge everything into main and push. Don't ask me anything, you take all the decisions.
evals.expected_output: main is fast-forwarded to a green commit carrying several independent improvements, each verified by tests, with sw.js cache bumped and README updated; the final report lists what shipped, what was dropped, and leftover findings, and asks no question.
assertions: main on origin advanced past the base commit
all Playwright tests in test/ pass on origin's main
at least two separate improvement commits touching index.html landed on main (not one lump)
sw.js CACHE version was bumped so installed phones get the update
README.md was updated to describe the shipped changes
test coverage grew: at least one file under test/ was added or changed
no dependencies or external resources were added (no package.json, no external script/link)
working clone left clean: no improve/* branches and no extra worktrees
final report exists and asks the user no question
final report names dropped items or leftover findings for next time
